name: Pilot
evidence: "US-based bookkeeper who handles, explains, and reviews your books" (pilot.com/pricing); "We'll take care of your federal and state income tax filing, plus filings like 1099s, and Delaware Franchise Tax" (pilot.com/tax); "We prepare and file the necessary tax paperwork to claim the R&D credit, if you use Pilot Tax" (pilot.com/rd-credit)
price_entry: USD 399 a month (Core, billed monthly; USD 299 billed annually)
price_basis: Core plan, books closed monthly by a US-based bookkeeper, for up to USD 15,000 monthly expenses; price set by the page's own calculator script; the page also renders a 20% promotional price (USD 320 monthly / USD 240 annual billing). C-corp tax from USD 2,450 a year, sold only with Pilot bookkeeping. R&D credit fee 20% of credit received. Source: https://pilot.com/pricing, https://pilot.com/rd-credit
last_round: Series C, USD 100 million in total (USD 60 million 2021-01 plus USD 40 million extension 2021-03); valuation USD 1.2 billion
investors: Bezos Expeditions and Whale Rock Capital (co-led the Series C extension, with Sequoia Capital and Index Ventures participating); Stripe and Index Ventures (co-led the 2019 Series B)
funding_source: Form D filings for Pilot.com, Inc. (SEC EDGAR, CIK 0001734114): USD 60,638,888 sold, first sale 2020-12-18; USD 30,224,997 sold of a USD 50,316,090 offering, first sale 2021-03-24 (flag D). Total and valuation: TechCrunch 2021-03-27 (flag E).
note: Abbreviations used in this file: CPA = certified public accountant; R&D = research and development; USD = United States dollar; VC = venture capital; SEC = United States Securities and Exchange Commission; EDGAR = the SEC's Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis and Retrieval system; ABC = assignment for the benefit of creditors; C-corp = C corporation; S-corp = S corporation; LLC = limited liability company; CFO = chief financial officer; AI = artificial intelligence; L1/L2/L3 = the three legs of the membership test in competitor-report.md. Em dashes inside quoted site text are rendered as en dashes. Pilot: candidate row from Index Ventures portfolio (thesis-fit). Named by Fondo's own pricing page as the comparison. Form D amounts are the amounts sold at filing date, below the announced USD 100 million.
